name: The Scarab God

abilities.text: At the beginning of your upkeep, each opponent loses X life and you scry X, where X is the number of Zombies you control.
{2}{U}{B}: Exile target creature card from a graveyard. Create a token that's a copy of it, except it's a 4/4 black Zombie.
When ~ dies, return it to its owner's hand at the beginning of the next end step.

notes: The first two abilities are the parser's own reading, kept because the script replaces the face. The death trigger sets up a delayed trigger at the next end step that returns the card (`move` of `self`, which resolves the source wherever it now is, CR 400.7).

issues: {2}{U}{B}: ... Create a token that's a copy of it, except it's a 4/4 black Zombie. — expected Only P/T, color and creature types are overwritten; any non-creature subtypes of the copied card (e.g. an artifact subtype) survive the 'except' clause. — scripted except.subtypes:['Zombie'] — withException (src/engine/ops/copy-clone.ts:166) REPLACES the whole subtype array, so a copied Artifact Creature — Equipment token loses 'Equipment' too. Edge case only; the creature-type replacement itself is right. — CR 707.9 / 707.2

When The Scarab God dies, return it to its owner's hand at the beginning of the next end step. — expected The delayed trigger returns the specific card that was put into the graveyard; if it has since left the graveyard (reanimated, exiled, shuffled in) it is a new object and nothing returns. — scripted delayed-trigger -> {op:'move', what:'self', to:'hand'} — resolves the source wherever it now is; the script's own note says so. In practice it will yank the God back from any zone it happens to be in at the next end step. — CR 400.7, 603.7d

each opponent loses X life and you scry X — expected scry X, X = Zombies you control — scripted correct at the engine level (scry takes an AmountRef and game.ts:1433 evaluates it); the renderer prints 'scry [object Object]' (render.ts:533 interpolates the Amount object) — a renderer gap, not a script defect. — CR 701.17

When The Scarab God dies, return it to its owner's hand at the beginning of the next end step. — expected The delayed trigger returns the card only if it is still in the graveyard it went to; if it changed zones again the effect loses track of it (CR 400.7). — scripted delayed-trigger -> move what:'self' to hand, which resolves the source wherever it now is. Non-blocking: only differs if the card is moved out of the graveyard in between. — CR CR 400.7, 603.7

each opponent loses X life and you scry X — expected X = number of Zombies you control, both halves. — scripted count 'permanents-you-control' filter {subtypes:['Zombie']} for both — correct at the engine level (evalAmount, characteristics.ts). Renderer prints 'scry [object Object]' (render.ts gap for an Amount-valued scry), a rendering defect only; scry accepts AmountRef in schema-core.ts:658 and game.ts:1433 evaluates it.

Create a token that's a copy of it, except it's a 4/4 black Zombie. — expected Token copy keeps the copiable values but is 4/4, black, and its creature type is Zombie (replacing others); it stays legendary. — scripted copy-permanent target:'that' with except {power:4,toughness:4,colors:['B'],subtypes:['Zombie']} — withException (copy-clone.ts:157-176) REPLACES subtypes and colors and leaves supertypes alone, which is right; copySources resolves 'that' from item.affected (the just-exiled card) regardless of zone. Verified correct. — CR CR 707.2
